key_concepts: The oxygen–carbon dioxide cycle links respiration and photosynthesis
Animals take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide
Plants use carbon dioxide and release oxygen
The sun drives evaporation in the water cycle
Condensation forms clouds and precipitation returns water to Earth
Plants return water vapor to the atmosphere through transpiration
Atmospheric nitrogen must be converted before organisms can use it
Denitrification returns nitrogen to the atmosphere
Ammonification converts organic nitrogen into ammonia
Assimilation is uptake of nitrogen compounds by organisms
Simple household activities like leaving faucets or lights on impact the environment
Mitigation includes conserving water and electricity and reducing waste
